tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying po'i don gyi sdom pa'i mtha' gcod gser gyi spu gri zhes bya ba bzhugs/
༄༅/ /'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying po'i don gyi sdom pa'i mtha' gcod gser gyi spu gri zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying po'i don gyi sdom pa'i mtha' gcod gser gyi spu gri zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na mo mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ sku gsum ye shes go 'phang mchog brnyes te/ /theg gsum gdul byar rang blo dang 'tsham par/ /rnam gsum 'khor lo bskor nas don mdzad pa'i/ /srid gsum ston pa de la gus phyag 'tshal/ /mgon de'i bstan pa'i snying po 'dul gzhung gi /dgongs don 'grel pa'i gsung rab mang mchis kyang*/ /rnam dpyod ldan pa 'ga' la phan pa'i ched/ /'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying po'i dgongs don bri/ /de yang spyi 'dul ba'i gzhung don rnams bsdu na rnam pa gsum du 'du ste/ sdom pa ma thob pa thob par byed pa dang*/ thob pa mi nyams par bsrung ba dang*/ nyams na phyir bcos pa'i gzhi gsum du'o/ /dang po ni sdom pa thob byed kyi thabs rnams te/ 'di la bsnyen gnas dge bsnyen dge tshul dge slong gi sdom pa thob byed rnams su yod pa las/ 'dir bsnyen rdzogs kyi dbang du byas na lung las bsnyen par rdzogs pa 'os pa rnam pa bcu'o/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar rang byung gi bsnyen par rdzogs pa sogs bcu ste/ gzhan rnams la cho ga'i rig byed dngos med cing*/ gsol bzhi'i cho ga'i sgo nas bsnyen par rdzogs pa la ni sngon chog dang da lta'i cho ga gnyis so/ /gnyis pa thob pa mi nyams par bsrung ba ni/ sdom pa'i mi mthun phyogs ngo shes nas bsrung ba dang*/ gso sbyong*/ dbyar gnas/ dgag dbye sogs byas pa'i sgo nas bsrung ba'o/ /gsum pa nyams na phyir bcos pa ni/ phyir bcos kyi skor te de la ni ltung ba phyir bcos dang rtsod pa phyir bcos gnyis so/ /skabs 'dir 'chad bya'i gzhung ni rje bla ma'i gsung rab kyi nang tshan 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying po ste/ de nyid las/ gang la brten nas bde blag tu/ thar pa'i grong du bgrod pa'i thabs/ bde gshegs bstan pa'i snying po mchog /so sor thar ces grags pa gang*/ /ngo bo dang ni rab dbye dang*/ /so so'i ngos 'dzin skye ba'i rten/ /gtong ba'i cha dang phan yon te/

/rnam pa drug gis ji bzhin bshad/ ces mdor bstan nas lhag ma rnams kyis rgyas par 'chad do/ /'di rnams kyi tshig 'grel yongs rdzogs rgyas tsam zhig bdag gis gzhan du bris zin pas 'dir mi brjod la/ don 'grel gtso bor byas pa'i mtha' gcod dang bcas pa zhig bshad par bya ste 'di la bdun/ ngo bo bshad pa dang*/ dbye ba dang*/ so so'i ngos 'dzin dang*/ skye ba'i rten dang*/ gtong ba'i rgyu dang*/ bsrung ba'i phan yon dang*/ de dag las 'phros pa'i dogs gcod do/ /dang po la gnyis/ sdom pa'i rgyu rkyen dang*/ ngo bo gang yin bshad pa'o/ /dang po la phyi dang nang gi rgyu gnyis las nang gi bsam pa ni/ nges 'byung bsam pas rgyu byas nas/ zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ spyir dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'i skyabs 'gro ni sdom pa thams cad kyi rten du dgos shing*/ khyad par du so thar gyi sdom pa'i rgyur nges 'byung gi bsam pa dgos pa yin la/ de yang*/ rje'i lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum las/ de ltar bsgoms pas srid pa'i phun tshogs la/ /yid smon skad cig tsam yang mi skye zhing*/ /nyin mtshan kun du thar pa don gnyer blo/ /byung na de tshe nges 'byung skyes pa lags/ zhes gsungs pa ni/ nges 'byung khyad par can la dgongs pa ste 'di ni mkhan slob kyis 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dang thar pa'i phan yon tshig gis brda sprad pa'i tshe/ bsgrub bya'i rgyud la de yin no snyam du go ba la brten nas bcos ma'i nges 'byung phal pa tsam skyes pas kyang go chod par bshad pa ltar 'thad do/ /gal te de tsam zhig kyang ma skyes na'ang phyis nges 'byung skyes pa'i skabs su sngar blangs pa'i sdom pa min pa'i tshul khrims kyi cha de sdom par 'gyur ba yin zhes mkhas pa kha cig bzhed pa ltar yang 'thad par sems so/ /des na de'i tshe rab byung byed pa kha cig la sdom pa ma skyes pa srid kyang bar ma'i tshul khrims nges par skye'o/

/gnyis pa ngo bo ni/ gzhan gnod gzhi dang bcas pa las/ /ldog pa de yang lus ngag las/ gzugs can yin zhes 'dod pa dang*/ /spong ba'i sems pa rgyun chags pa/ /sa bon dang bcas yin no zhes/ /'dod pa'i tshul ni rnam pa gnyis/ /rang gi sde pa gong 'og smra/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'di la bye brag smra ba rnam pa gnyis kyis ni/ so thar gyi sdom pa ngo bo gzugs can du 'dod cing*/ de yang gtso bor rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs su 'dod pa yin te/ mdzod las/ rnam rig min rnam gsum zhes bya/ /sdom dang sdom pa min dang gzhan/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /'on kyang so thar gyi sdom pa skad cig dang po de la der gyur ba'i rnam par rig byed yin min gnyis yod de/ de nyid las/ dang po'i rnam rig rnam rig min/ /so sor thar dang bya ba'i lam/ /zhes pa dang*/ mdzod 'grel las/ las kyi lam gzugs can bdun ni gdon mi za bar rnam par rig byed dang rnam par rig byed ma yin pa gnyis ka yod do zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /skad cig gnyis pa man chad rnam par rig byed ma yin pa gtso che zhing*/ kha cig de man rnams rig min pas khyab ces gsungs/ rnam rig min pa'i sdom pa de ni dge bar lung du bstan cing thogs med kyi gzugs yin te/ mdzod las/ lung bstan thogs pa med pa'i gzugs/ zhes gsungs pas so/ / rnam par rig byed yin min ni/ kun slong gzhag la rig pa byed cing sgo nas yin zhing*/ rig byed ni lus ngag tu gsal por thon pa'i tshe 'byung la rig byed min pa ni gnyid dang snyoms 'jug dang g.yeng ba la sogs pa'i gnas skabs kun du rgyun chags su 'byung bar bshad cing*/ dge mi dge gang rung gis bsdus pa yin gyi/ lung ma bstan yin pa med de/ mdzod las/ rnam rig min lung bstan min med/ ces gsungs pas so/ /mkhas pa kha cig mdo sde pas so thar gyi sdom pa spong sems mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa kho nar 'dod ces gsungs la/

gzhan dag spong sems sa bon dang bcas pa la 'dod ces pa dang*/ kha cig des sdom pa la gzugs can yin min gnyis ka yod par 'dod ces zer/ mang pos sems tsam pa dang rang rgyud pas spong sems sa bon dang bcas pa la 'dod cing*/ thal 'gyur bas lus ngag gi sdom pa gzugs can du bzhed ces bshad/ kha cig mdo sems gnyis kyis kyang so thar gyi sdom pa la gzugs can yod par 'dod de/ de med na de gnyis kyi lugs la lus ngag gi mi dge ba'i las spang bya'i gtso bor mi byed par thal bar 'gyur zhes 'dod do/ /sdom pa gzugs can du 'dod pa'i lugs la yid kyi tshul khrims yod kyang de sdom par mi bzhed de/ lus ngag gi mi dge ba gtso bor spong ba'i dbang du mdzad pa'o/ / theg chen pa'i lugs la yid gtso che bas yid kyi spong sems sdom par bzhed de/ spyod 'jug las/ spong ba'i sems ni thob pa las/ tshul khrims pha rol phyin par bshad/ ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ sdom pa blangs pa'i rgyud kyi sgo gsum gyi kha na ma tho ba spong ba'i sems byung zhig la spong sems zhes brjod pas na/ sdom ldan gang zag gi rgyud kyi spong sems mngon 'gyur pa sa bon dang bcas pa sdom pa yin kyang*/ de min pa'i gang zag gi rgyud la sdom pa'i sa bon yod kyang de sdom pa min no/ /dge slong gi sdom pa ni lus kyi gsum dang ngag gi bzhi ste spong ba bdun gy-i bdag nyid yin la/ dge tshul gyi sdom pa ni spong ba bzhi ldan yin te/ dag gi phra ma tshig rtsub ngag kyal gsum spong bar dngos su khas ma blangs pa'i phyir zhes gsung pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa dbye na brgyad de/ bsnyen gnas dge bsnyen pha ma dang*/ /dge tshul pha ma dge slob ma/ /dge slong ma dang dge slong ste/ /so sor thar pa rigs brgyad do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /brgyad kyi dang po bsnyen gnas dang dge bsnyen pha ma gnyis kyi sdom pa ste gsum ni khyim pa'i phyogs kyi sdom pa dang*/

gzhan dge tshul pha ma sogs lnga'i sdom pa ni rab byung phyogs kyi sdom pa yin te/ khyim pa'i sdom pa dang po gsum/ /rab byung sdom pa tha ma lnga/ /zhes gsungs/ phyogs zhes pa'i don ni/ /sdom gsum rim gyis blangs pa'i dge slong gi rgyud kyi dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa de khyim pa'i sdom pa dngos yin pa 'gog pa'i ched do/ /so thar gyi sgra don ni/ srung ba po so sor 'khor ba las thar bar byed pa'am/ sdom min las dang por thar pa'o/ /sdom pa'i sgro don ni nyes spyod las bsdoms pa'i don no/ /gsum pa so so'i ngos 'dzin la drug las dang po bsnyen gnas ni/ /rtsa ba bzhi dang yan lag bzhi/ /brgyad spong bsnyen gnas sdom pa'o/ /zhes mdor bstan nas rgyas par 'chad pa ni/ mi tshangs spyod dang ma byin len/ srog gcod brdzun du smra ba rnams/ rtsa ba bzhi yin mal che mtho/ /chang 'thung gar sogs phreng sogs dang*/ /phyi dro'i kha zas yan lag bzhi/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa dge bsnyen ni/ /gsod brku smra dang log par g.yem/ /myos 'gyur 'thung ba lnga spong ba/ /dge bsnyen gyi ni sdom pa'o/ /zhes yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyi spang bya bstan nas/ dge bsnyen de la sgras brjod rigs kyis dbye na drug ste/ sna gcig sna 'ga' phal cher spyod/ /yongs rdzogs spyod dang tshangs spyod dang*/ /skyabs 'gro'i dge bsnyen rnam pa drug/ces gsungs so/ kha che bas yongs rdzogs dang tshangs spyod gnyis ma gtogs gzhan rnams dge bsnyen dngos min par 'dod la/ nyi 'og dang mdo sde pa gnyis kyis de rnams dge bsnyen dngos yin kyang dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa yod pa'i nges pa med do zer/ de dag gi spang bya'i khyad par ni/ rtsa ba bzhi las gcig gnyis gsum/ /'dod log mi tshangs spyod spong dang*/ skyabs 'gro tsam gyis dge bsnyen du/ khas len rnams dang go rim bzhin/ /zhes gsungs te/ snga ma bzhi ni rtsa ba bzhi las gcig gnyis gsum dang bzhi ka spong ba'i sgo nas dang*/

lnga pas mi tshangs spyod kyang spong zhing*/ drug pas skyabs 'gro khas blangs pa'i sgo nas 'jog ces pa'o/ /gsum pa de tshul ni/ rtsa ba bzhi dang yan lag drug/bcu spong dge tshul sdom pa'o/ /zhes mdor bstan nas rgyas par 'chad pa ni/ rtsa bzhi dang chang mal che mtho phyi dro'i kha zas ste gsum gyi steng du/ gar sogs phreng sogs rnam gnyis dang*/ gser dngul len dang rnam pa gsum/ /phye bas yan lag drug tu 'gyur/ /zhes spang bya bcu ngos bzung nas de'i yan lag 'chad pa ni/ mkhan por gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ khyim pa'i rtags ni spong ba dang*/ /rab byung rtags ni yen pa las/ /nyams pa rnam gsum bsnan pa yis/ /spang bya bcu gsum dag tu 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bzhi pa dge slob ma ni/ dge tshul sdom pa thob rjes su/ /rtsa ba'i chos drug rjes mthun gyi/ /chos drug spong ba'i sdom pa ni/ /dge slob ma yi sdom pa yin/ /zhes mdor bstan nas/ rgyas par 'chad pa la de dag gang zhe na/ gcig pu lam du 'gro mi bya/ /chu bo'i pha rol rkyal mi bya/ /skyes pa la ni reg mi bya/ / skyes pa dang ni 'dug mi bya/ /gnyen du 'gyur bar mi bya zhing*/ kha na ma tho 'chab mi bya/ /de dag rtsa ba'i chos drug spong*/ /gser la bzung bar mi bya zhing*/ / 'doms kyi spu ni 'breg mi bya/ /byin len ma byas za mi bya/ /gsog 'jog byas pa bza' mi bya/ /tswa sngon mi gtsang 'dor mi bya/ /sa ni brko bar mi bya ba/ /rjes mthun chos ni rnam drug spong*/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar te go sla'o/ /lnga pa dge slong ma ni/ pham brgyad lhag ma nyi shu dang*/ /spang ba'i ltung byed sum cu gsum/ /lhung byed 'ba' zhig brgya brgyad cu/ /so sor bshags pa bcu gcig dang*/ /nyes byas brgya dang bcu gnyis te/ /sum brgya drug cu rtsa bzhi rnams/ /spong bar byed pa dge slong ma/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /drug pa dge slong pha ni/ /pham pa bzhi dang lhag ma ni/

/bcu gsum slad ltung sum cu dang*/ / ltung byed 'ba' zhig dgu bcu dang*/ /sor bshags bzhi dang nyer byas ni/ / brgya rtsa bcu gnyis bsdoms pa yis/ /nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum rnams/ /spong bar byed pa dge slong ngo*/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ 'di dag gi don ni bdag gis 'di'i 'grel pa dang*/ /bslab bya gzhan dang*/ 'dul ba'i yig char yang bris zin pas 'dir rgyas par mi 'chad do/ /rigs brgyad po de dag bsdu na rdzas rigs bzhir 'du ste/ dge slong pha ma gnyis kyi sdom pa rdzas rigs gcig /dge tshul pha ma dang dge slob gsum rdzas rigs gcig /dge bsnyen pha ma gnyis rdzas rigs gcig /bsnyen gnas rdzas gcig ste bzhi'o/ /'o na dge slong pha ma dge slong ngo zhes bshad cing dge slong ma la dge slong ngo zhes pa'i sgra gsal khar mi snang bas/ dge slong ma de dge slong min nam snyam na/ rje'i rim lnga gsal sgron sogs las dper na bu tsam dbye gzhir byas nas de la bu pho mo gnyis su dbye ba ltar/ rgyud la'ang pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis su phye ba de bzhin du/ dge slong dbye gzhir byas nas de la dge slong pha ma gnyis su 'byed pas dge slong ma ni dge slong yin la/ 'dir dge slong pha la dge slong ngo zhes brjod pa ni spyi ming bye brag la btags pa ste de 'dra mang ngo*/ /bzhi pa skye ba'i rten sogs ni/ de ltar so thar rigs brgyad po/ /sgra mi snyan pa ma gtogs pa'i/ /gling gsum skyes pa bud med kyi/ /rten la skye yi za ma dang*/ /ma ning mtshan gnyis sogs la min/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ skye ba'i rten ni go sla la/ rten min ma ning dang*/ mtshan gnyis sogs zhes pa'i sogs sgras mtshan med dang*/ mtshams med byas pa dang*/ rku thabs su gnas pa dang*/ pham pa 'chab bcas byung ba sogs dang*/ lha dang mi ma yin pa'i 'gro ba gzhan par sdud do/ /de dag gi rten de la so thar mi skye yang de rnams kyi rgyud la ni spyir sdom pa skye bar 'dod dgos te/

de dag gi rgyud la rnam mkhyen gyi sa bon yod pas so/ /spyir sdom pa skye ba dang gnas pa dang khyad par du 'gyur ba dang mdzes pa'i bar chad bzhi ste gnyis pa ni rgyal po dang pha mas ma gnang ba lta bu/ gsum pa ni nad pa lta bu/ bzhi pa ni lag dum la sogs pa lta bu'o/ /'di gsum gyi rten la ni sdom pa skye yang 'bog pa po la nyes byas su 'gyur ba tsam mo/ /lnga pa gtong ba'i rgyu la gnyis/ dngos dang*/ 'dod tshul gzhan no/ /dang po ni/ sdom pa gtong ba'i rgyu la gnyis/ zhes mdor bstan nas/ de la thun mong ba dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gtong rgyu gnyis kyi dang po ni/ bslab pa phul dang shi 'phos dang*/ mtshan gnyis byung dang lan gsum 'gyur/ /dge rtsa chad rnams thun mong ste/ /zhes gsungs la/ gnyis pa ni/ nyi shu ma lon der shes dang*/ /bsten phyir khas blangs nyin zhag 'das/ /rim bzhin dge slong dge slob ma/ /bsnyen gnas rnams kyi thun mong min/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ phyi ma'i don lo nyi shu ma lon par bsnyen par rdzogs mi rung yang*/ gal te rdzogs par byed na bshol zla dang mngal gyi zla ba rnams kyi kha bskang bar bya la/ de ltar bskang kyang lo nyi shu ma tshang na bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa mi skye zhing tshang na skye'o/ /sngar lo nyi shu ma lon par bsnyen par rdzogs nas phyis de ltar mi rung bar shes pa'i tshe lo nyi shu lon na sdom pa de mi gtong yang*/ ma lon na sngar skyes pa'i bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa de gtong bar 'gyur zhing*/ dge slong mas 'khrig pa bsten par khas blangs pa dang*/ bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa nyin zhag gcig 'das pa na gtong ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba byung ba dang*/ dam pa'i chos ni nub pa las/ /sdom pa gtong zhes 'dod pa'ang yod/ kha che bye brag smra ba rnams/ /sdom ldan rtsa ltung byung ba la/ /bu lon nor can bzhin du 'dod/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ mdo sde pas rtsa ltung 'chab bcas byung na gtong bar 'dod la/

sems tsam pa yan chad kyis rtsa ltung gang byung yang gtong bar bzhed/ gos dmar sde bas lung gi dam pa'i chos nub pas kyang gtong bar 'dod/ kha che bye brag smra bas ni rtsa ltung 'chab bcas byung ba'i dge slong de tshul khrims dang ldan pa dang tshul 'chal yang yin par 'dod de/ mi 'ga' zhig la bu lon 'jal dgos kyang yod la/ nor yang yod pa bzhin no zer/ drug pa bsrung ba'i phan yon ni/ sdom pa de dag bsrungs pa las/ /gnas skabs 'bras bu lha mi dang*/ /mthar thug 'bras bu byang chub gsum/ /'thob par 'gyur zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ /brtson ldan rnams kyis so sor thar/ /rtag tu gus pas 'bad de bsrung*/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar te sla'o/ /bdun pa 'phros pa'i dogs gcod la/ rgyu dang ngo bo la dogs gcod bshad zin cing*/ 'dir sdom pa thob tshul dang*/ gtong tshul dang*/ ltung ba'i khyad par dang*/ sdom pa gong ma gnyis blangs pa'i tshe ji ltar 'gyur ba'i tshul dang*/ rten gang gis sdom pa gang len du rung mi rung dpyad pa dang lnga/ dang po ni/ spyir sdom pa de la so thar gyi sdom pa dang*/ bsam gtan gyi sdom pa dang*/ zag med kyi sdom pa gsum dang*/ rnam grangs gzhan yang yod do/ /'dir so thar gyi sdom pa thob pa la cho ga nges par mi dgos te/ ye shes khong chud dang*/ tshur shog dang*/ dri bas mnyes pa'i sgo nas skyes pa'i bsnyen rdzogs ky-i sdom pa rnams la cho ga mi dgos pa'i phyir te/ dang po ni/ bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes gsar du rgyud la skyes pa tsam gyis dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ ston pas tshur shog tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod cig ces gsungs pa tsam gyis dang*/ gsum pa ni/ gcig tu dge ba ni gang*/ thar pa'o/ /de la dgos pa ni gang*/ dad pa'o/ /zhes pa tsam gyis bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa thob pa yod pa'i phyir/ gang las thob pa ni/ dge slong pha ma dang dge slob ma'i sdom pa ni dge 'dun dang*/

gzhan lnga gang zag las kyang thob pa yin te/ mdzod 'grel las/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa de yang dge 'dun nam gang zag las te/ dge slong dang dge slong ma dang dge slob ma'i sdom pa ni dge 'dun las so/ /gzhan dag ni gang zag las so zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang gzhan lnga ni dge 'dun las blangs kyang phun sum tshogs par 'gyur zhing*/ kha cig de dag dge 'dun las len na bsgrub bya sum tshan du gcod dgos kyi/ ma bcad na skye la nyes byas su 'gyur bar bzheng*/ kha cig dge bsnyen dang bar ma rab byung gnyis la sum tshan du ma bcad kyang nyes par mi 'gyur zhe bzhed cing*/ bsnyen gnas la ni de ltar mi dgos so/ /dus ni bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa de bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad par btsun pas bzung du gsol zhes pa dang*/ dge bsnyen la dge bsnyen du zhes pa dang*/ dge tshul la dge tshul du zhes pa'i skabs dang*/ bsnyen rdzogs la ni bsnyen par rdzogs par gsol na zhes pa'i skabs su skye zhing*/ de yang rang rang gi cho ga lan gsum re brjod pa'i phyi ma'i dus su'o/ /spyir bar ma rab byung gi tshul khrims tsam ni sdom pa min yang*/ dge bsnyen sngon du song ba'i bar ma rab byung gi rgyud la sdom pa yod cing*/ bar ma'i tshul khrims len pa'i cho ga lan gsum brjod pa'i mjug tu bar ma rab byung gi tshul khrims thob pa dang rab tu byung ba dus mnyam mo/ /de dag thob tshul dngos ni de'i tshe chu lon gyi tshul du spong ba gzugs can pa re skyes pa na thob par 'jog ste/ dper na chu lon nam chu rag gis chu 'gog pa ltar/ ltung ba 'gog pa'i spong sdom dge ba zhig skyes pa'o/ /dge bsnyen sogs kyis sdaum gsum rim gyis blangs ba'i tshe cho ga tha dad pa las blangs pas sdom pa gsum rim gyis rdzas tha dad du thob pa yin gyi/ gnas 'gyur du mi 'dod de/ mdzod las/ tha dad de dag 'gal ba med/ /ces gsungs pas so/

/gzhan yang dge 'dun nam gang zag dang las lam gyi sbyor dngos mjug gsum dang*/ gzhi sems can yin min gnyis dang*/ phung khams las dang*/ sems can thams cad las kyang thob pa zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa gtong tshul ni/ spyir sdom pa gtong ba la sor shor dang*/ kun gtong gi lugs gnyis yod kyang*/ bslab pa phul bas gtong ba ni/ dge slong gi bslab pa tsam phul na dge slong gi sdom pa gtong yang gzhan mi gtong*/ des dge tshul phul na dge slong dge tshul gnyis ka gtong*/ dge bsnyen phul na sdom pa dang mi ldan pa'am/ sdom gsum ldan pa'i dge slong gis rang rgyud kyi dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa phul na dge tshul dang dge slong gi sdom pa gnyis gtong mi dgos pa 'dra ste dpyad do/ /sdom gsum ldan pas sdom pa thams cad cig car du phul na ni thams cad gtong ngo*/ /der ma zad dge slong gis dge tshul lam dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa blangs pa'am/ bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa blangs na'ang rang gi sdom pa gtong bar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong zhig gis khyim par zhe bas khas blangs na rab byung gi sdom pa thams cad gtong ngo*/ /so thar gyi sdom pa rigs bdun ni ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bsrung bas khas blangs kyi/ de phan chad du khas ma blangs pas shi ba'i tshe rten bor nas sdom pa gtong ste nyes pa med la/ phul ba la nyes med dkon no/ /pho mo'i mtshan ma gnyis snga phyi'i byung ba tsam gyis sdom pa mi gtong yang*/ de gnyis cig car du byung na gtong ngo*/ /bye smra'i lugs la dge rtsa chad pa'i gang zag 'dod pas dge rtsa chad pa na sdom pa'i gzhi med pa'i phyir de gtong ngo*/ /dbu ma pas ni dge rtsa chad pa'i gang zag mi 'dod de/ sems can thams cad 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pa'i phyir ro/ /spyir rtsa ltung sdom pa'i gtong rgyur mi mdzad kyang*/ sems tsam yan chad kyi lugs la rtsa ltung byung na sdom pa gtong zhing*/ de yang 'chab med byung na gtong yang phyis blang du rung la/

'chab bcas byung na blang du mi rung bar bzhed/ mdo sde pas ni 'chab med byung na sdom pa mi gtong bas len mi dgos la/ 'chab bcas byung na sdom pa gtong zhing*/ slar blangs kyang mi skye bar 'dod ces bshad do/ /'dir 'chab bcas dang 'chab med ni rtsa ltung byung ma thag 'gyod pa dang bcas te gzhan la mi sbed par brjod pa'am/ dgos pa'i dbang gis ma brjod kyang 'gyod pa chen po dang bcas pa yin la/ 'chab bcas ni mi 'gyod bzhin du sbed pa'o/ /bye smra'i lugs la pham pa gnyis gang byung yang sdom pa mi gtong mod/ sdom pa rnam dag las nyams par byed cing*/ 'chab bcas kyis dgos pa sgrub nus las kyang nyams par byed de/ de byung na tshe 'dir byang chub mi thob par gsung*/ kha cig nyi 'og pas pham pa 'chab bcas byung na sdom pa gtong bar 'dod ces zer te/ bzhed pa mi 'dra ba'ang yod do/ /ba byung gis spyir khyim pa'i sdom pa blangs na rab byung gi sdom pa gtong bas len du mi rung yang*/ bsnyen rdzogs slar bskyar nas bsgrub pa'i tshe dge bsnyen nas rim gyis bsgrubs pas dge slong gi sdom pa snga ma rnying pa gtong zhing*/ bsnyen par rdzogs pa na sdom pa gsar pa skye bas khyad par shes dgos so/ /gsum pa ltung ba'i khyad par bshad pa la gnyis/ ltung ba de rten gang la 'byung ba dang*/ ltung ba'i khyad par dngos so/ /dang po ni/ kha na ma tho ba tsam ni sdom pa blangs ma blangs gnyis ka'i rten la 'byung yang*/ ltung ba'i nyes pa ni sdom pa thob pa la 'byung gi /ma thob pa la mi 'byung ngo*/ /sdom pa yang so thar gzhir bzhag tshe rtsa ba bzhi spong bar khas blangs pa zhig gis thob par 'jog gi /rtsa bzhi spang bar khas ma blangs pa la ni tshul khrims tsam yin gyi so thar gyi sdom pa med do/ /'on kyang dge slong gi sdom pa ni spang bya nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum ci rigs spong ba'i sgo nas 'jog pa yin gyi/ rtsa ba bzhi spong bar khas blangs pa tsam gyis mi 'jog go

/gal te dge slong gi khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum gyi tshul khrims thams cad sdom pa yin nam min/ yin na sdom pa grangs mang ba dang*/ pham pa byung ba'i tshe tshul khrims de thams cad gtong bar thal bar 'gyur ro/ /min na rtsa ba bzhi spong ba'am spong bdun gyi tshul khrims tsam zhig sdom par 'gyur bas sdom pa grangs nyung bar 'gyur ro zhe na/ 'di la lan dka' bar snang na'ang*/ bu ston rin po'i mdo rtsa'i ṭīkkar/ so thar gyi sdom pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ chos 'di bdag gi 'dod pa na spyod pa'i tshul khrims so zhes gsungs te/ 'di la stag tshang lo tsā bas 'di ba'i legs smon dang 'jigs skyob kyi tshul khrims gnyis mtshan nyid de yin kyang so thar gyi sdom pa min pa'i skyon bstan pa tsam ma gtogs de bzhin du 'dod/ mkhas pa kha cig nges 'byung gi bsam pas zin pa'i 'dod pa'i sas bsdus pa'i tshul khrims de/ so thar gyi sdom pa'i mtshan nyid du 'dod do/ /de ltar na bye smra'i lugs la dge slong gi sdom pa ni spong bdun 'khor bcas kyis bsdus kyang grangs mang ba'i skyon med de/ lhag ma sogs gzhan spong ba'i tshul khrims rnams kyang bdun ci rigs kyis bsdus pa'i phyir te/ 'dir lus ngag gi spang bya bdun spong ba gtso che bas gzhan rnams de dag gi yan lag tu srung bar byed pa ste de dag la ma gtogs pa'i zur pa min no/ /des na dge slong gi sdom pa ni spong bdun 'khor bcas kyis bsdus kyang*/ spang bya'i grangs kyi ldog cha nas nyis brgya sogs grangs mang po khas blangs pa la 'gal ba med de/ nyin zhag re re la bltos pa'i dge slong gi sdom pa'i dbye cha mang du yod kyang mi 'gal ba bzhin no/ /rtsa bzhi srung par khas blangs pa'i sgo nas lhag ma sogs gzhan spong bar khas blangs pa'i tshul khrims kyang sdom par 'gyur gyi/ rtsa bzhi srung ba'i sdom pa la ma bltos par de rnams rang stobs kyis sdom par mi 'gyur ro/

/'dir lus ngag gi mi dge ba bdun spong ba'i spong bdun gyi tshul khrims de gzugs can du 'dod pa ni lhag ma nas nyes byas kyi bar gyi tshul khrims thams cad gzugs can du 'dod dgos pa'i don te/ dge slong gi spang bya nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum po thams cad kyang lus ngag gi las ci rigs par 'du ba'i phyir/ des na tshul khrims dang tshul 'chal gnyis ka'ang gzugs can du bzhed cing*/ tshul 'chal ni mi dge ba'i gzugs yin te/ mdzod las/ 'chal ba'i tshul khrims mi dge'i gzugs/ /de spong tshul khrims rnam gnyis so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gzhan yang*/ 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying po las/ brgyad spong bsnyen gnas sdom pa'o/ /zhes dang*/ lnga spong ba/ dge bsnyen gyi ni sdom pa'o/ /zhes dang*/ bcu spong dge tshul sdom pa'o/ / zhes dang*/ chos drug spong ba'i sdom pa ni/ dge slob ma yi sdom pa yin/ zhes gsungs nas/ dge slong ma'i skabs su sum brgya drug cu rtsa bzhi'i spang bya spong ba'i tshul khrims dang*/ dge slong gis spang bya nyis brgya nga gsum spong ba'i tshul khrims rnams kyang de gnyis kyi sdom par don gyis bstan to/ /sngon gyi 'dul 'dzin mang pos dge slong gi sdom pa nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum yod kyang*/ rtsa bzhi gang rung byung ba'i tshe rang rang gi gnyen po'i sdom pa gtong zhing gzhan mi gtong ngo zhes dang*/ lhag ma lta bu gcig shor ba'i tshe yang de'i ngos skal gyi sdom pa gtong gi /gzhan mi gtong zhes gsungs pa'i dang po ni dpyad par bya ba'i gnas yin la/ phyi ma shin tu mi 'thad de/ lhag ma tsam byung bas sdom pa gang yang mi gtong ba'i phyir te/ des de gtong ba tshad ldan sus kyang ma bshad pa'i phyir/ sdom pa spong sems sa bon dang bcas pa ci rigs la 'dod pa dag gi lugs la'ang tshul de ltar du sbyar bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa ltung ba'i khyad par la/ spyir nyes pa la bcas rang gi kha na ma tho ba gnyis yod cing*/

de'i khyad par yang gtso bor ston pa'i bcas pa dang 'gal ba tsam gyis bzhag pa'i kha na ma tho ba de/ bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba'i mtshan nyid/ bcas pa la ma bltos par nyer bar 'gyur ba'i kha na ma tho ba de/ rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba'i mtshan nyid dam don no/ /mtshan gzhi ni/ sdom ldan gyis chang 'thung ba dang*/ phyi dro'i kha zas za ba dang*/ khyim pa'i rtags 'chang pa dang*/ rab byung gi rtags spong ba dang*/ rin po che dang me la reg pa sogs dang*/ gso sbyong sogs mi byed pa dang*/ glu gar sogs byed pa dang*/ sa rko ba dang*/ shing gcod pa dang*/ 'tshong ba sogs kyi spyod lam dang zas gos sogs tshul bzhin ma bsten pa las byung ba'i ltung ba rnams ni bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba'am nyes pa dang*/ srog gcod sogs lus ngag gi bdun dang yid kyi gsum dang bcas pa'i mi dge bcu sogs gang gis byas kyang nyes par 'gyur bas rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba ste/ sdom pa blangs ma blangs gnyis ka'i rten la 'byung ba rnams so/ /bcas rkyang gi nang nas chang 'thung ba dang mi sha za ba gnyis ma gtogs/ gzhan rnams ni nad pa sogs rkyen la bltos te gnang ba yod la/ rang bzhin gyi lhung bar 'gyur ba la 'dir rtsa ba bzhi byed pa gnang ba med cing*/ gzhan rkyen la bltos te gnang ba srid do/ /'on kyang theg chen gyi skabs su srog gcod sogs lus ngag gi bdun yang gnang ba yod cing*/ yid kyi gsum ni gnang ba med de khyad par ro/ /ji ltar bskyed pa ni/ ltung ba sde lnga'i dngos gzhi bskyed pa la sdom ldan zhig dgos kyi/ sdom pa ma chags pa 'am rtsa ltung 'chab bcas byung ba sde lnga la zhugs kyang nyes byas tsam du 'gyur la/ pham pa 'chab med byung ba la bslab pa byin pas ltung ba'i dngos gzhi ji lta ba bzhin bskyed ces bye smra 'dod do/ /ltung ba gang du bskyed tshul ni/ skabs 'dir 'du shes gtso che bas dge slong gis shes bzhin du mi bsad na pham pa dang*/

dge tshul la pham 'dra'i nyes byas 'byung ba sogs yin la/ dngos po gtso che ba yod de/ mi tshangs par spyod pa dang*/ khu ba 'byin pa gnyis dngos po gtso che bas 'du shes 'khrul ma 'khrul 'dra'o/ /des na mi gsod sems med par 'du shes 'khrul te bsad na pham pa yod med gnyis te gzhan la'ang ci rigs sbyor/ spyir dge slong gis mi bsad pa las pham pa/ mi ma yin pas bsad pa las sbom po/ /dud 'gro bsad pa las ltung byed 'byung ba yin yang*/ 'du shes 'khrul ba dang*/ gzugs gzhan du bsgyur ba dang*/ mtshan gyur ba lta bu'i skabs su sbyor dngos la khyad par yod de/ mi gsod pa'i sbyor ba la sbom po yin yang*/ mi la dud 'gror 'khrul nas gsod pa'i sbyor ba nyes byas dang*/ dngos gzhi la pham pa/ dud 'gro la mir 'khrul nas gsod pa'i sbyor ba sbom po dang dngos gzhi la ltung byed/ /mi ma yin mir 'khrul te gsod pa'i sbyor dngos gnyis ka la sbom por 'gyur ba yod de/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis zhib par phye na shin tu mang yang de tsam mo/ /bzhi pa sdom pa gong ma blangs pa'i tshe ji ltar 'gyur ba la/ sngon gyi mkhas pa du mas so thar byang sems gsang sngags kyi sdom pa gsum rim gyis blangs pa na/ sdom pa snga ma snga ma phyi ma phyi mar gnas 'gyur bar 'dod cing*/ 'di la'ang sdom pa de gsum gyi gzhi mthun 'dod mi 'dod pa'i tshul gnyis snang ngo*/ kha cig bye smra'i lugs la so thar gyi sdom pa gzugs can yin yang*/ theg chen gyi skabs su sdom pa shes pa kho na 'am/ spong sems sa bon dang bcas pa la 'dod pas mi 'gal zhes gsungs te brtag /gong ma'i lugs la ni/ sdom pa gsum po de len pa'i tshe cho ga rigs tha dad pa las blangs pas gnas 'gyur du mi 'dod la/ de'i tshe gang zag gcig gi rgyud la ldog pa tha dad pa'i tshul gyis yod par mkhas pa du mas bshad pa ltar 'dod pa yin no/ /'on kyang spong sems rigs mthun rdzas tha dad pa cig car yod pa la rigs pas gnod pas/

de lta bu rdzas gcig pa'am yang na rigs mi mthun par 'dod dgos par mngon no/ /des na gong ma'i lugs la sdom pa gsum la ngo bo tha dad mi dad gnyis 'dod dgos par sems la/ ngo bo gcig na gcig khegs pa'i tshe cig shos khegs pas ma khyab ste/ dngos po dang bum pa bzhin no/ /byang sdom blangs pa'i tshe so thar byang sdom gyi yan lag tu 'gyur zhing*/ sngags sdom thob pa'i tshe de gnyis ka'ang sngags sdom gyi yan lag tu 'gyur te gong ma gtso che ba'i phyir te/ mkhas grub rje'i thub bstan byi dor las/ 'on kyang gnas skabs su 'og ma bsrung ba yang gong ma'i kun slong khyad par can gyis zin pa'i rkyen gyis gnas skabs kyi rkyen de dang ma bral gyi ring la 'og ma yang gong ma'i yan lag tu 'gyur ba yin gyi/ grub sde dbyer med dang rigs rgyun phan tshun gcig bkag pa'i cig shos khegs pa'i yan lag tu 'gyur ba ma yin te/ dper na snod dwangs shing dri ma med par chu shin tu dwangs pa'i nang du rin po che mar gad la sogs pa bcug pa na de srid du chu'i kha dog kyang rin po che'i kha dog gi yan lag tu 'gyur mod kyi/ chu dang rin po che de dag phan tshun gcig bkag kyang cig shos mi khegs pa bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'on kyang sngags sdom gyi yan lag yin pa tsam gyis sngags sdom du mi 'gyur ro/ /sdom gsum gyi gzhi mthun med de/ so thar gyi sdom pa rnams ni shi ba'i tshe gtong la/ gzhan gnyis 'gal rkyen med na byang chub kyi snying po'i mtha' can yin pa'i phyir/ byang sems kyi sdom pa dang sngags sdom gnyis kyi gzhi mthun kyang 'jog dka' ste/ sngags sdom ni dbang la bltos la/ byang sdom ni de la ma bltos pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang sdom gsum gyi gzhi mthun med de/ de gsum len pa'i rgyu tha dad cing*/ gtong rgyu yang tha dad pa'i phyir/ gzhan du na gcig blangs pas thams cad blangs pa dang gcig btang bas kun gtong bar thal bar 'gyur na de mi 'dod do/

/'o na/ dge bsnyen/ dge tshul/ dge slong gi sdom pa gsum rgyud ldan zhig la srog gcod kyi pham pa byung ba'i tshe dge slong gis srog gcod spong ba'i sdom pa gtong zhing*/ gzhan gnyis kyi srog gcod spong ba'i sdom pa mi gtong bar 'gyur te/ sdom pa gsum po de dag len pa'i rgyu cho ga rigs tha dad pa'i phyir dang*/ sdom pa gong ma gnyis blangs pa'i tshe 'og ma mi gtong ba'i phyir dang*/ so thar byang sems gsang sngags kyi sdom pa gsum po de gtong ba'i rgyu so so bar nges pa'i phyir zhe na/ bye brag smra ba ltar na de gnyis mtshungs pa ltar snang yang 'dir de gnyis mi mtshungs te/ sdom gsum ldan pa'i dge slong zhig gis sbyor dngos mjug gsum tshang ba'i sgo nas mi bsad na rang rgyud kyi dge bsnyen dge tshul dge slong gi srog gcod spong ba'i sdom pa gsum car gtong ba'i phyir te/ de ltar mi bsad pa'i ltung ba dngos gzhi de rtsa ltung du 'gyur ba dge bsnyen sogs gsum po de la mtshungs pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang dge slong gi ngos skal gyi pham pa dang dge tshul gyi sdom pa'i ngos skal gyi pham pa 'dra gnyis 'byung mi 'byung brtag dgos so/ /gal te/ de'i tshe mi tshangs spyod sogs ma byas pas rtsa ltung gzhan gsum mi 'byung ngo snyam na/ bye smra dang snga rabs pa kha cig de ltar 'dod mod/ 'dir de mi 'dod de/ rtsa ba bzhi las gang rung gcig byung na sdom pa gtong bar khas len rigs pa'i phyir te/ dper na/ khang pa ka ba bzhi pa can gcig gi ka ba gcig med par byas pa'i tshe ka ba gzhan gsum gyis dgos pa mi 'grub pas khang pa yang bshig par 'jog pa bzhin no/ /'on kyang mkhas pa kha cig sngags kyi skabs su rtsa ltung 'chab bcas byung yang so thar mi gtong ste/ sngags kyi khyad chos dang bsam pa'i khyad par du 'dod de dpyad byar snang ngo*/ kha cig sdom pa gong ma blangs nas gtso bor srung ba'i tshe sdom pa 'og ma gnas tshul ni dper na nyi ma shar ba'i tshe zla ba dang rgyu skar gyi 'od yod kyang zil gyis mnan nas mi mngon pa 'dra'o zhes gsungs shing*/

yang kha cig sdom gsum chang chu 'o ma gsum bsres pa dang 'dra bar 'dod la/ gzhan dag gi bsnyen sogs gsum gyi sdom pa gsum gang zag gcig gi rgyud la dong tshe brtsegs pa lta bu dang*/ rgyan mi 'dra ba btags pa dang 'dra bar 'dod de dpe phyogs tsam mo/ /lnga pa rten gang gis sdom pa gang len du rung mi rung la/ rab byung gis khyim pa'i sdom pa len mi rung bar sngar bshad zin cing*/ gzhan bsnyen gnas kyis dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa len du rung yang blangs pa'i tshe bsnyen gnas gtong bar sems so/ kha cig dge bsnyen gyis bsnyen gnas len du mi rung zhes bzhed kyang*/ mkhas pa mang pos khyad par shes na len du rung par 'dod de/ de'i tshe dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa mi gtong bas bsnyen gnas gyi sdom pa dge bsnyen gyi gso sbyong du 'gyur zhes bzhed pa ltar 'thad par sems so/ /de gnyis kas dge tshul dang dge slong gi sdom pa len pa ni shin tu rung yang sdom gsum rim gyis blangs pa'i dge slong gi rgyud la bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa 'byung ba tshad ldan gyis ma gsungs pas de'i rgyud la de med par sems so/ /de rnams kyis byang sdom dang sngags kyi sdom pa ni skabs su babs pa na len du rung la/ go rim gyi dbang du byas na khyim pas dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa blangs nas byang sdom dang sngags sdom len dgos pa yin yang*/ byang sdom dang sngags sdom blangs rjes su yang dge bsnyen dang bsnyen gnas kyang shes na blang du rung ste/ de gnyis khyim pa'i sdom par mtshungs shing*/ sngags kyi sdom pa'i yan lag tu 'gyur gyi gtong rgyur mi 'gro ba'i phyir/ gal te sngags pa khyim pas de gnyis len du mi rung na/ de 'dra ba des dge tshul dang dge slong gi sdom pa blang du mi rung bar 'gyur na/ de ni mi 'thad de/ sngags pa khyim pa'i rten can du mas byis bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa blangs pa 'phags yul dang bod kyi yul du'ang du ma byung bar lo rgyus 'chad pa'i bstan bcos mang po las kyang 'byung ba'i phyir ro/

/des na gsang sngags pa khyim pas dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa blang du mi rung ngo zhes ma zer cig / gal te dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa ni 'og ma yin la/ sngags kyi sdom pa ni mtho bas so snyam na de yang ma nges te/ de ltar na dge tshul dang dge slong gi sdom pa yang len mi rung bar 'gyur zhing*/ sngags pas gsung rab klog pa dang gto 'phen pa dang bza' btung byed pa sogs kyang mi rung bar 'gyur te de dag kyang 'og ma'i bya ba yin pas so/ /gal te de rnams ni thun mong ba'o snyam na cig shos la'ang mtshungs so/ /des na des dge bsnyen dge tshul dge slong gi sdom pa gang blangs na'ang sngags sdom mi gtong la/ sngags sdom blangs na'ang de gsum mi gtong ngo*/ /bsnyen gnas dngos ni rab byung gis len du mi rung yang*/ theg chen gyi bsnyen gnas sam smyung gnas ni dge slong dge tshul sogs dang sngags pas kyang len du rung bar bshad do/ /'on kyang 'di dang bsnyen gnas gnyis nyin zhag gcig gi mtha' can du khas len dgos pas de'i tshe bsam pa 'dzin tshul khyad par phyed dgos te/ so thar gzhan dang sdom pa gong ma gnyis ni nyin zhag gi mtha' can min pas so/ /so thar gyi sdom pa rnams ni thog mar dge 'dun nam gang zag gi drung du len dgos la/ byang sdom ni len yul gang zag ma rnyed na thog ma nyid nas rang gis rten gyi drung du blangs kyang skye bar bshad cing*/ sngags sdom ni thog mar bla ma las dbang gi dus su len pa yin la/ nyams na phyis rang gis bdag 'jug byas nas len du rung ngo*/ /sdom pa gong ma gnyis kyi gtong rgyu'i gtso bo rang gi rtsa ltung du mngon no/ /bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa ni spyir rang gis nam srung ba'i nyin zhag re re bzhin gyi nang par len dgos par bshad cing*/ 'on kyang mdzod 'grel las/ gang gis tshes brgyad la rtag tu bsnyen gnas la gnas par bya'o zhes sngon yang dag par khas blangs pa des ni zan zos nas kyang nod par bya'o zhes pa 'dis tshes brgyad kyis mtshon te dus bzang rnams la bsnyen gnas srung bar 'dod pas dus gcig tu len pa'i tshul zhig bstan pa'i don la/

kha cig nya stong tshes brgyad sogs la bsnyen gnas srung bar dus gcig tu khas blangs kyang de ni phyis tshes brgyad sogs kyi dus su zan zos rjes su 'ang rten gyi drung du cho gas blangs na skye ba'i ched yin gyi/ slar cho gas ma blangs na mi skye zhes 'dod la/ kha cig de min gyi sngar cho gas blangs pa'i rkyen gyis tshes brgyad sogs kyi dus su nang bar bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa skyes zin kyang srung bar brjed nas zan zos pa'i rjes su dran na sdom pa skye ba'i bsam pa gsal btab ste bsrung ba'i don du bzhed de/ 'dir nod par bya'o zhes pa'i don nod pa ni gsal bar byas pa'i phyir ro zhes gsungs pa ltar bsam pa gsal 'debs pa'i don yin gyi/ sdom pa len pa'i don min no zhes gsung ba ni 'thad pa ltar snang ngo*/ /da lta jo mo'am btsun ma zhes grags pa 'di la kha cig sdom pa ster ba'i nges pa med par rab byung gi rtags tsam zhig sbyin par byed pa snang yang*/ srung ba po la phan 'dogs pa'i bsam pas legs pa zhig byed na pho mo'i khyad par tsam ma gtogs/ dge bsnyen bsgrubs nas rab byung gi rtags tsam zhig tshig gis sbyin pa'am rab byung bya ste/ sdom pa ma blangs bzhin du blangs pa ltar bcos na ni mi legs shing*/ de blangs ma blangs gnyis las blangs te bsrungs na phan yon che ba'i phyir ro/ /bsgrub tshul de ltar byas na tshangs spyod la gnas pa'i go ma'i dge bsnyen du 'gyur ba'am/ rab byung mar 'gyur bas legs so/ /'o na/ so thar byang sems gsang sngags kyi sdom pa gsum ka bsrung ba'i tshe nang 'gal tshogs par gyur na ji ltar bya snyam na/ 'di la gong ma gtso che yang dgag bya dang dgos pa gang che ba'i dbang du gtong dgos pa yod de/ sa paṇa gyis/ sdom gsum ldan pa'i gang zag gis/ /spang bya phan tshun nang 'gal tshe/ /dgag bya dang ni dgos pa gnyis/ /gtso bo gang che'i dbang du thong*/

/zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /de yang spyir/ gong 'og gi rtsa ba nang 'doms pa'i tshe gong ma bsrung dgos la/ 'og ma'i rtsa ba dang gong ma'i yan lag nang 'doms na 'og ma'i rtsa ba bsrung dgos te/ spyod 'jug las/ chung ngu'i phyir ni re mi btang*/ /gtso cher gzhan gyi don bsam mo/ /zhes gsung pa ltar yin la/ dmigs bsal gzhan yang snang ngo*/ /de ltar dpyad par bya ba'i gnas mang yang re zhig de tsam mo/ /smras pa/ 'dul gzhung rgya mtsho bsrubs pa las byung ba'i/ /legs bshad snying po bdud rtsi'i cha shas tsam/ /rnam dpyod ku sha'i rtser blangs bkod pa 'di/ /thar 'dod srog gi nyer 'tshor 'gyur bar shog /ces 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying po'i don gyi sdom pa'i mtha' gcod ces bya ba 'di yang shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis bgyis pa ste/ yi ge pa ni rnam dpyod ldan pa'i sngags ram pa kun dga' chos 'byor ro// //padma laṃ/ /dge legs 'phel lo// u hu lags/ bla ma rdo rjai 'dzin pa chen po la sogs pa phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma ma mchis pa na da lta la thug gi bar du/ nyon mongs pa 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug gis dbang gis/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas sdig pa mi dge ba bcu bgyis pa dang*/ mtshams ma mchis pa lnga bgyis pa dang*/ de dang nye ba lnga bgyis pa dang*/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang 'gal ba dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa dang 'gal ba dang*/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig dang 'gal ba dang*/ pha dang ma la ma gus pa dang*/ mkhan po dang slob dpon la ma gus pa dang*/ grogs tshangs par mtshungs par spyod pa rnams la ma gus pa dang*/ dkon mchog gsum la gnod pa'i las bgyis pa dang*/ dam pa'i chos spangs pa dang*/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la skur ba btab ba dang*/

sems can la gnod pa'i las bgyis pa la sogs pa/ sdig pa mi dge ba'i tshogs bdag gis bgyis pa dang*/ bgyid du stsal ba dang*/ gzhan gyi bgyis pa la rjes su yi rang ba la sogs pa/ mdor na mtho ris dang thar pa'i gegs su gyur cing 'khor ba ngan song gi rgyur gyur pa'i nyes ltung gi tshogs ci mchis pa thams cad bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la sogs pa phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams kyis spyan sngar mtho lo/ /mi 'chab bo/ /'chags so/ /phyin chad sdom par bgyid lags so/ /mthol zhing bshags na bdag bde ba la reg par gnas par 'gyur gyi/ ma mthol ma bshags na ni mi 'gyur ro/ /bkra shis so// //
